data.title: Burj Binghatti
data.about:
Burj Binghatti, when completed, will be the world's highest residential structure in Dubai.

This collaboration will be mirrored in the design aesthetics of the new tower, taking influence from Jacob & Co. 

You'll find more than just gorgeous architecture and luxurious luxury here. 

Choose from a stunning range of 2 to 7-bedroom apartments, mansions, and penthouses, all with exceptional finishing methods inspired by Jacob & Co's horological and design philosophy. 

A luxurious tower with more than 100 storeys in the heart of Business Bay. This is a safe sanctuary for those who will not conform.

characteristics_module.title: World’s Tallest Residential Tower
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Diamond-Inspired Architecture: Crown design reflects Jacob & Co’s most iconic watch pieces
  • Design-First Residences: Every inch infused with luxury design language by a global jeweler
  • The Art of Rarity: Ultra-limited units crafted to embody exclusivity and personal expression
  • Sky-High Identity: Residences that redefine status by their altitude and attitude
  • Timepiece to Tower: Conceptual transition of Jacob & Co craftsmanship into real estate form
  • Haute Living Experience: A seamless fusion of fashion, function, and prestige
  • Sculpted for Icons: Designed for elite individuals who don’t settle for ordinary
  • Luxury Without Limits: From valet to skyline views, every detail speaks opulence
  • Personalized Lifestyle Curation: Services and spaces tailored like a bespoke suit
  • Crown of Dubai: A symbolic address representing power, beauty, and timeless value

location_tile.title: Live the Pulse of the City in Business Bay
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Burj Binghatti is surrounded by some of Dubai's most renowned monuments and sights. You will discover calm in the heart of a bustling metropolis with the wonderful nature sanctuary of Ras Al Khor nearby. The artistic few may easily reach Dubai Design District and Dubai Creek Harbour, a limitless magnificent neighborhood.

  • 2 minutes to Dubai Water Canal
  • 5 minutes to Downtown Dubai
  • 7 minutes to Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall
  • 10 minutes to DIFC
  • 15 minutes to Dubai International Airport
  • 17 minutes to Burj Al Arab
  • 20 minutes to Dubai Marina
  • 22 minutes to Jumeirah Beach Residence
